text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

After the final evaluation meeting ended—
an elderly gentleman walked into the conference room alone.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text:
This project began because I was spurred on
by her passion and proposed it.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text:
The dream she spoke of became my dream as well.
That is precisely why I used every connection at my disposal
to support her from behind the scenes up to this point.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text: These past three years... or more accurately, two and a half years, is it? You've delivered solid results.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text:
A splendid facility, and fully upgraded!
You've completed a truly one-of-a-kind place for us.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Which means—!

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text:
"The project was a massive success—!
It's safe to say a magnificent training facility complex
has been born!"

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text: Let's begin operating this as a training facility.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text: —Even so.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text:
If it truly comes down to long-term operation,
it's going to require a tremendous amount of cost.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, as you may already know,
it will be on a provisional basis for a while,
so we can assess this location's utility.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text: While Tracen Academy is already a wonderful training facility, if we can prove that this place is also necessary—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, as long as there is clear growth in the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: URA Senior Executive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As an official training facility,
let us transition to a long-term operational plan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phaaaah~!
I was... so nervous~...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "Anyway! The result is a resounding success! Thanks to your generous cooperation, Tracen Island is complete!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Thanks again!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the real battle begins now...!
Regardless, we must gather the Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"You're right...! If we want to 'prove its usefulness,'
we need lots of different girls running as much as possible!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still, hmm... I wonder if it'll be okay...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: No need for concern!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Even if it's only on a trial basis, it's been recognized as a training facility. That gives us something to draw people's interest with!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
With the construction settled down,
I too can devote my full energy to PR activities!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
There's still plenty we can do...!
I want all of you to keep exploring every possibility as well...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Above all else...
I don't wanna give up after coming this faaaar!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...That's so true! We came all this way.
It'd be such a waste if it all went down the drain!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely gettin' this up and runnin'!
Let's combine our strength—and fire up our souls!"

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

Great work for now, everyone!
A wonderful training facility has been completed!

Taking a brief breather like that...
I psyched myself up once more
for the busy days ahead running here and there.
